title: HKDSE Paper 3: Listening & Integrated Skills
learning_objectives: Master the decoding of diverse accents (British, American, Australian, Local)
Develop speed processing and ambiguity handling
Enhance strategic note-taking and gist extraction
Synthesize auditory information into integrated tasks

learning_content.title: Pillar 1: Decoding & Processing (The Ear)
learning_content.description: Focus on low-level mechanics: Accent, Speed, and Ambiguity.
learning_content.dse_objective: Accurately parse words despite accent, speed, or noise.
learning_content.british_tutor_hint: Don't let the accent throw you. Focus on the stressed vowels.

learning_content.title: Pillar 2: Strategic Capture (The Pen)
learning_content.description: Focus on mid-level strategy: Prediction and Note-taking.
learning_content.dse_objective: Efficiently record key details and the general gist.
learning_content.british_tutor_hint: Use abbreviations. If they say 'approximately', write '~'.

learning_content.title: Pillar 3: Critical Synthesis (The Brain)
learning_content.description: Focus on high-level interpretation: Attitude and Integration.
learning_content.dse_objective: Interpret tone and synthesize data into formal tasks.
learning_content.british_tutor_hint: Listen to the pitch. High pitch often means surprise or sarcasm.

quest_types.title: Listening Mission
quest_types.description: A complete scenario testing all 3 pillars.
